title: Work with a clear outcome.
description: Your private operations workspace. Add evidence, assign a bounded task, review the exact action, and keep its receipt.
loginDescription: Sign in to review your team’s work.
taskNotice: Hermes prepares a draft and proposed commitments using selected evidence. Approval records them here. Email delivery is not connected.
emptyTasks: No workflows yet. Add knowledge, then give your team a bounded request.
approvalNotice: Approval saves this draft and its commitments inside this workspace. It does not send an email. Changing the action or its evidence invalidates approval.
knowledgeDescription: Text notes, meeting transcripts and procedures. Versions and source hashes stay attached to the work. Keep passwords and API keys out of knowledge.
emptyKnowledge: No knowledge yet. Start with a meeting transcript or a team procedure.
memoryTitle: A record of work that happened.
emptyMemory: Approved, completed workflows will appear here.
connectionsNotice: Only internal draft storage is active. External accounts require their own scoped authorization and verification before they can be used.
genericError: The request could not be completed. Try again or inspect the workflow outcome.
